ei.title: 의사결정의 길잡이: 타인의 선택을 통해 얻는 확신과 정보

fullPassage: Imagine looking for a parking spot. After driving around for what seems like forever, you find a whole side of a street free of cars. Success! But excitement quickly turns to concern: If no one else parked here, maybe I shouldn't, either. There might be street cleaning or some special event that makes parking there illegal. If there are even a couple other cars parked on the street, though, the concern disappears. You feel more confident that you've found a legitimate spot. Trying to sort out which dog food to buy or which preschool to send your child to? Knowing what others have done provides insight into what might be best for you. Talking to other dog owners who have similar breeds will help you figure out the right food option for your dog's size and energy level. Talking to other parents will help you figure out which schools have a good student-teacher ratio and provide the right mix of learning and play.

questions.passage: Imagine looking for a parking spot. After driving around for what seems like forever, you find a whole side of a street free of cars. Success! But excitement quickly turns to (A)[____ / relief]: If no one else parked here, maybe I shouldn't, either. There might be street cleaning or some special event that makes parking there illegal. If there are even a couple other cars parked on the street, though, the concern disappears. You feel more (B)[confident / anxious] that you've found a legitimate spot. Trying to sort out which dog food to buy or which preschool to send your child to? Knowing what others have done provides (C)[insight / confusion] into what might be best for you. Talking to other dog owners who have similar breeds will help you figure out the right food option for your dog's size and energy level. Talking to other parents will help you figure out which schools have a good student-teacher ratio and provide the right mix of learning and play.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② concern — confident — insight: 흥분이 걱정으로 바뀌고, 다른 차가 있으면 확신을 얻으며, 타인의 경험이 통찰을 준다
❌ ① relief(안도)는 excitement 뒤에 부정적 전환이 와야 하는 맥락과 불일치
❌ ③ anxious(불안한)는 legitimate spot을 찾았다는 긍정 맥락과 모순
❌ ④ confusion(혼란)은 provides 뒤 긍정적 정보 제공 맥락과 모순

If there are even a couple other cars parked on the street, though, the concern (B)[disappears / increases]. You feel more confident that you've found a (C)[legitimate / suspicious] spot. Talking to other dog owners who have similar breeds will help you figure out the right food option for your dog's size and energy level. det.analysis:

❌ ① ordinary(평범한)는 불법 주차의 특수한 상황 설명과 불일치
❌ ② increases(증가한다)는 다른 차가 있을 때 안심되는 맥락과 반대
❌ ④ suspicious(의심스러운)는 confident와 결합하여 모순
